answer: The island I would price into every new account is Signed physiotherapy attendance record: sessions a clinic logged week after week, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so sessions a clinic logged week after week stays private; the jade is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The inlet is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
